description: Government of Jersey (Mapping) publishes the locations of public facilities in Jersey with their Unique Property Reference Numbers and map coordinates, as separate files for bus shelters, car parks, recycling centres and public toilets according to the portal description and resource list. Coverage: the island of Jersey; the portal record was last modified on 2025-08-15. Format and access: CSV, JSON, downloadable without registration from the Government of Jersey open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence – Jersey v1.0; cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the record counts, the attribute columns and whether capacity or opening hours are given are unconfirmed; the dataset is a point inventory of amenities, not of buildings. Simulation uses: amenity and public-space location layers for accessibility and evacuation-planning models, and facility points to join with parcel and road layers. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
